_about: What every live chart should look like (Claude, 2026-10-29). analysis/vps_health.py compares the day's trade log with it in the 16:40 CT job: a missing chart heartbeat, an unexpected chart, or an entry with the wrong size is flagged in the journal and the dashboard. Update it whenever a chart, size or account changes. qty = fixed contracts (null = risk-sized: max_qty is the ceiling).
_accounts_about: start / trail / lock / max_stop / started per live account (2026-10-30): the watchdog computes the Apex EOD trailing floor from the Chart Monitor's equity (floor = min(peak EOD equity - trail, lock)) and alarms when equity nears or touches it. phase: evaluation or funded.
